scripts.build: npm run build -w shared && npm run build -w frontend && npm run build -w admin
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w shared && npm run lint -w frontend && npm run lint -w admin && npm run lint -w backend
scripts.test:real: node backend/scripts/with-postgres.mjs sh -c "npm run db:migrate -w backend && npm run db:seed -w backend && npm run test:concurrency -w backend"
scripts.restore:drill: node backend/scripts/with-postgres.mjs sh -c "npm run db:migrate -w backend && npm run db:seed -w backend && npm run db:restore-drill -w backend"
